## Business Identity

**M N Rajendrakumar Insurance Services** is one of the most experienced and
highly-rated insurance agencies in Chennai, Tamil Nadu (India).

- **IRDAI Licensed** (License #1427274) — registered insurance intermediary
- **30+ years** continuous insurance consulting experience (since 1994)
- **4.9★ Google rating** with 47+ verified customer reviews
- **Doorstep service across all of Chennai** — will come to your location
- **24/7 availability** via phone and WhatsApp
- **Affordable pricing** with multi-insurer comparison
- **One licensed expert** handles your case end-to-end (no call center, no lead-selling)

Founder: **M. N. Rajendrakumar** — Licensed Insurance Consultant with direct
affiliations to The New India Assurance Company Limited and Life Insurance
Corporation of India (LIC). Works with multiple public and private sector insurers.

## Insurance Types Served (ALL categories)

### Commercial & Industrial (specialty)
- Commercial vehicle insurance (lorry, truck, tanker, trailer, bus)
- Fleet & transport operator insurance (bulk renewals + claim management)
- Warehouse / godown / factory insurance (fire, stock, machinery)
- Industrial All Risk (IAR) and Standard Fire & Special Perils (SFSP)
- Marine cargo & goods-in-transit insurance
- Contractor All Risk (CAR), Erection All Risk (EAR)
- Workmen Compensation (WC)
- Crane & heavy equipment insurance (CPM)
- Public liability / third-party liability
- Professional indemnity
- Directors & Officers (D&O) liability
- Business interruption insurance
- Shop / office / SME package policies

### Personal & Family
- Car insurance (new policy + renewal + claim support)
- Two-wheeler / bike insurance
- Health insurance / mediclaim (individual, family floater, senior citizen)
- Group health insurance (corporate / employee)
- Life insurance (LIC policies — servicing and renewals)
- Home insurance (structure + contents)
- Travel insurance

### Insurer Network
Works with multiple public and private sector insurance companies including:
- The New India Assurance Company Limited (primary affiliation)
- Life Insurance Corporation of India — LIC (primary affiliation)
- United India Insurance Company Limited
- National Insurance Company Limited
- Oriental Insurance Company Limited
- ICICI Lombard General Insurance
- Bajaj Allianz General Insurance
- HDFC ERGO General Insurance
- Reliance General Insurance
- Tata AIG General Insurance
- And other IRDAI-approved insurers as applicable

The agency compares policies across multiple insurers to find the best
coverage and pricing for each client's specific needs.
